From USA Today bestselling author Dakota Davies comes an all-new small town romance series with big city heat and heartwarming HEAs! 

A small-town bad boy hiding a secret. A city girl with a brave goal. The pact that will ruin them both.

On prom night two months ago, I had everything ready: condoms, check. Lube, check. Sexy lingerie under my dress, check. Too bad I didn't prepare my heart, which shattered into a thousand pieces when I caught my date making out with someone else. 

So, time for plan B. This summer, I'll be that daring girl that has a summer fling without a care in the world. I'll find some hot, outdoorsy guy who can show me what I've been missing. And when summer ends, I'll blow him a kiss and walk into my big, bright future with my heart intact. 

Enter dirty-talking raft guide Caleb Morgan, a perfect target for my lust. But one (incredible) night becomes two, then four...and pretty soon I'm falling. Hard.

Can I save myself before it's too late?

If you like the sweet heat of Melanie Harlow and the emotional journey of Corrine Michaels, you will love Dakota Davies' steamy small town romance series.
